properties.entry: SELECT P.SERIAL_NO, P.ITEM_ID, I.MODEL_NAME, I.COLOR, P.STOCK_ORDER, P.IS_SOLD, TO_CHAR(P.IN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS IN_DATE, TO_CHAR(P.OUT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS OUT_DATE FROM PRODUCT P INNER JOIN ITEM I ON P.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID WHERE P.ITEM_ID = ? ORDER BY SERIAL_NO ASC
INSERT INTO PRODUCT (SERIAL_NO, ITEM_ID, STOCK_ORDER) VALUES (?, ?, ?)
